newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya sells $114 million in treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Kenya sells $114 million in treasury bills.

text.p: The Central Bank of Kenya sold 6.661 billion shillings ($114 million) in treasury bills at its weekly auction on Thursday, bank officials said.

The bank sold 4.710 billion shillings at an average yield of 18.269 percent of the benchmark 91-day treasury bills compared to 6.388 billion shillings at an average yield of 18.2338 percent last week.
In the 182-day category, the bank sold 1.951 billion shillings at an average yield of 19.248 percent compared to 1.505 billion shillings at a yield of 19.330 percent last week.
The bank invited tenders for nine billion shillings of treasury bills for next week's auction on Thursday.
